dct_description_sm:
Mapping depicts Brampton Plan Schedule 6a Natural Heritage Feature Areas, which indicate site specific policies therein. Refinements to the boundaries of natural features and areas, as confirmed through detailed studies such as watershed plans, subwatershed studies, and Environmental Implementation Reports, may occur.

This data is intended to be used in conjuction with other related mapping layers for this schedule, and may be impacted by other schedules, with consideration to the text of Brampton Plan.
